{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Define the 'improved' metric as the change in biomarker
# Remove sentinel values (-999) for baseline
valid_data = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Compute change in biomarker
valid_data['biomarker_change'] = valid_data['biomarker_final'] - valid_data['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute response rate by arm
response_by_arm = valid_data.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()

# Compute average change in biomarker by arm
avg_change_by_arm = valid_data.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].mean()

# Check if treatment arm has higher response rate
response_improvement = response_by_arm['treatment'] - response_by_arm['control']

# Check if treatment arm has higher biomarker change
change_improvement = avg_change_by_arm['treatment'] - avg_change_by_arm['control']

# Check if the arms are comparable across severity
arm_severity_cross = pd.crosstab(valid_data['arm'], valid_data['severity'])

# Check if severity is associated with response and change
severity_response = valid_data.groupby('severity')['responded'].mean()
severity_change = valid_data.groupby('severity')['biomarker_change'].mean()

response_improvement, change_improvement, severity_response, severity_change"}
